title: FirstAwakening
body:
Mysterious person: Oh, good. You're awake. You've been in and out of consciousness.
Hana: Where am I? Why am I here?
Mysterious person: Don't worry Hana, you're just back at the bunker. 
Mysterious person: You're pretty banged up, take a rest. Did you run into one of those "Health Officers" again?
Hana: I can barely remember anything. How long have I been like this?
Mysterious person: We found you slumped at our entrance this morning... We've been worried sick since you took off last night.
Hana: What am I doing here? Who are you people?
Gabriel: Oh no, your condition worse than we thought. Rest up Hana. The outside world may not be how you remember it to be.
Hana: And how do you know my name?!
Gabriel: Hana, it's Gabriel! You rescued me from Health officers and brought me here remember? 
Hana: I think it's starting to come back to me... What do you mean... What happened to everyone?
Gabriel: People had been starting to act weird since last year... 
Gabriel: At first it was great, crime rates plummeted, I stopped getting cut off in traffic.
Gabriel: But I started to notice everyone around me just stopped feeling at all. They just seemed to be happy all the time.
Hana: That doesn't seem so bad...
Gabriel: I felt so alone. I feel like I had to perform in front of everyone.
Gabriel: When I found out it was that AI that caused all of this, I was blind with rage and planned to attack the DecaAI HQ. 
Gabriel: Of course the plan went sideways, then you brought me here...
Hana: I can't believe it... This cannot be true.
Gabriel: The authorities call it a utopia!! Nobody can resist! Or get angry at all for that matter.
Gabriel: The unvaccinated are deemed dangerous. Anyone showing negative emotions can be targeted for what the government calls "sanitation".
Hana: And everyone just accepts that!!? I don't know if I believe you.
Gabriel: Then go see the city for yourself! The library has public news terminals. See what the government is telling everyone.
<<explore_city>>
Hana: I'll look for myself. I need to know what is happening out there.

title: BackFromLibrary
body:
<<see_gabriel>>
Hana: Oh my god.. I...
Gabriel: I don't want to say I told you so
Hana: The news... It called anger... a symptom... Everything is so messed up...  
Hana: They all gathered around me... smiling like a bunch of FREAKS. I had to run back here...

title: Briefing
body:
Hana: What now? We have to do something!
Gabriel: We're about to conduct a mission now. We've been eyeing those datacentres right outside of town... 
Gabriel: They enable DecaAI's surveillance for the Federal Department of Sanitation. 
Gabriel: But we must be careful, there are Health Science Officers guarding its datacentres.
Gabriel: First we hit the peripheral centres: East, then West. 
Gabriel: Then we hit the main datacentres last. Alpha and Omega. 
Gabriel: From our intel, Omega holds the prompt terminal. If we make it there, we may be able to get Deca to reverse the inhibitor.
Gabriel: Four of us go to East tonight. We have to distract the guards, and then destroy the infrastructure.
Gabriel: Take these charges. There should be 4 server points to hit. We'll detonate when the coast is clear.
Hana: Are you sure about this?
Gabriel: Only if you are.
<<go_east>>
Hana: I'm ready.

title: SecondAwakening
body:
Hana: How did I get here?
Gabriel: Are you okay? You've been out for hours. The bomb must've detonated early.
Hana: I'm... feeling... fine... I want to continue
Gabriel: I hope you're sure about this...
Gabriel: But we are running out of time. Health Science Officers are closing in on us. 
Gabriel: We are the only ones who survived the last mission.
Hana: Oh no... 
<<alpha_next>>
Gabriel: We can't let their sacrifice go to waste. Let's go now, Alpha is next.
